user: Thanks. How does the review process work in general?
answer:
Summary of the review process (from Verta policy)
1. Eligibility check
   - Before a case is opened the agent verifies eligibility for the supplied reason code. Ineligible requests are refused and the failing condition is named.
   - For your transaction this check was completed and returned eligible.

2. Case opening and assignment
   - Once eligible the dispute is opened against the single settled transaction and assigned for review.

3. Review and state changes
   - The case moves through review states; each state change generates a notification that names the new state.

4. Customer options during review
   - You may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is final and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

What I did and current status for your case
- Dispute ID: 1 — status: open.
- Transaction date on record: 2026-07-20; dispute window / eligibility deadline: 2026-09-18.
- A human agent has been queued to review the case.

What happens next
- The queued reviewer will examine the case and the dispute will progress through the review states. You will receive notifications for each state change.
- If you want me to add any extra information or documents to the dispute now, tell me and I will attach them to the case.

fragments.text:
Complaints
## Difference from a dispute
A dispute concerns a specific transaction. A complaint concerns the service
itself: a delay, an error, or the conduct of an agent. The two follow separate
processes.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
